```{r}
# ========================
# LIBRARIES
# ========================
library(limma)
library(sva)       # ComBat
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)

# ========================
# STEP 1: Load & align
# ========================
counts   <- read.csv("Count_Matrix_removed_unknown.csv", row.names = 1)
metadata <- read.csv("Metadata_Limma_dead_time_all.csv", row.names = 1)

# Transpose: rows = miRNAs, cols = samples
counts <- t(counts)
colnames(counts)  <- trimws(colnames(counts))
rownames(metadata) <- trimws(rownames(metadata))

common_samples <- intersect(colnames(counts), rownames(metadata))
counts   <- counts[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
metadata <- metadata[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# ========================
# STEP 2: Log2 transform
# NanoString outputs are already normalized counts (floats).
# Do NOT use DGEList/TMM/voom — those require raw integer counts.
# ========================
log2_counts <- log2(counts + 1)   # miRNAs × samples matrix

# ========================
# STEP 3: Filter low-expression miRNAs
# Keep miRNAs with median log2 expression > 1 in at least one group
# This reduces the multiple testing burden (798 → ~500 miRNAs)
# ========================
dead_samps  <- rownames(metadata)[metadata$dead.status == 1]
alive_samps <- rownames(metadata)[metadata$dead.status == 0]

med_dead  <- apply(log2_counts[, dead_samps],  1, median)
med_alive <- apply(log2_counts[, alive_samps], 1, median)
keep      <- (med_dead > 1) | (med_alive > 1)

log2_counts <- log2_counts[keep, ]
cat("miRNAs after filtering:", sum(keep), "\n")

# ========================
# STEP 4: Factor variables
# ========================
metadata$dead.status <- factor(metadata$dead.status,
                                levels = c(0, 1),
                                labels = c("Alive", "Dead"))
metadata$Batch <- factor(metadata$Batch)

# ========================
# STEP 5: ComBat batch correction
# mod protects dead.status from being removed during correction — correct ✓
# ComBat is applied to log2 data directly (not voom output)
# ========================
modcombat   <- model.matrix(~ dead.status, data = metadata)
combat_expr <- ComBat(dat      = log2_counts,
                      batch    = metadata$Batch,
                      mod      = modcombat,
                      par.prior = TRUE,
                      prior.plots = FALSE)

print(table(metadata$Batch, metadata$dead.status))
# ========================
# STEP 6: PCA after ComBat
# ========================
pca_combat <- prcomp(t(combat_expr), scale. = TRUE)

pca_data <- data.frame(pca_combat$x,
                        Status = metadata$dead.status,
                        Batch  = metadata$Batch)

ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Status, shape = Batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  ggtitle("PCA after ComBat") +
  theme_bw()
ggsave("PCA_ComBat.png")

# ========================
# STEP 7: Limma DE — Dead vs Alive
# Design WITHOUT batch: batch variance was removed by ComBat.
# Use lmFit directly on log2 matrix (no voom needed — data is not counts).
# ========================
Design  <- model.matrix(~ 0 + dead.status, data = metadata)
colnames(Design) <- levels(metadata$dead.status)

fit     <- lmFit(combat_expr, Design)          # no weights argument
contrast <- makeContrasts(Dead - Alive, levels = Design)
fit2    <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast)
fit2    <- eBayes(fit2, trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)

results <- topTable(fit2, adjust = "fdr", number = Inf) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "miRNA")

# ========================
# STEP 8: Export
# ========================
write.csv(results, "DE_results_ComBat_dead.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Merge with expression table
expression_table <- as.data.frame(combat_expr) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "miRNA")

results_with_expr <- merge(results, expression_table,
                            by = "miRNA", all.x = TRUE)
write.csv(results_with_expr,
          "DE_results_ComBat_dead_with_expression.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# Transposed expression (samples × miRNAs) for downstream use
expression_table_df <- as.data.frame(t(combat_expr)) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "SampleID")
write.csv(expression_table_df, "combat_counts.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save PCA object
saveRDS(pca_combat, file = "pca_combat.rds")

head(results)
```

#Vocalno plot 
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
data <- read.csv("DE_results_ComBat_dead.csv")

# ── Define thresholds ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_thresh  <- 0.05
fc_thresh <- 0.5   # changed from 1 → 0.5

# ── -log10 P and category ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
data$neg_log_pvalue <- -log10(data$P.Value)

data$category <- with(data,
  ifelse(P.Value < p_thresh & logFC >  fc_thresh, "Up",
  ifelse(P.Value < p_thresh & logFC < -fc_thresh, "Down", "Not Sig")))

data$category <- factor(data$category, levels = c("Up", "Down", "Not Sig"))

# ── Select labels: top 5 up + top 5 down by logFC ─────────────────────────
top_up <- data[data$category == "Up", ]
top_up <- top_up[order(-top_up$logFC), ]
top_up <- head(top_up, 5)

top_down <- data[data$category == "Down", ]
top_down <- top_down[order(top_down$logFC), ]   # ascending = most negative first
top_down <- head(top_down, 5)

top_label <- rbind(top_up, top_down)

# ── Count sig miRNAs for subtitle ─────────────────────────────────────────
n_up   <- sum(data$category == "Up",   na.rm = TRUE)
n_down <- sum(data$category == "Down", na.rm = TRUE)

# ── Volcano plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
volcano_plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log_pvalue, color = category)) +
  
  # Points
  geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Up" = "firebrick", "Down" = "deepskyblue3", "Not Sig" = "grey70"),
    labels = c(
      paste0("Up (n=", n_up, ")"),
      paste0("Down (n=", n_down, ")"),
      "Not significant"
    )
  ) +
  
  # Threshold lines  ── linewidth replaces deprecated size ──
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_thresh, fc_thresh),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "lightsalmon", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_thresh),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "lightsalmon", linewidth = 0.7) +
  
  # Labels for top hits  ── aes(label = miRNA) not aes(label = df$col) ──
  geom_label_repel(
    data        = top_label,
    aes(label   = miRNA),          # fix: removed top_proteins_5$miRNA
    color       = "black",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    segment.size  = 0.4,
    size          = 3.2,
    max.overlaps  = 20,
    show.legend   = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # Axes and labels
  labs(
    title    = "Volcano Plot — Dead vs Alive (miRNA)",
    subtitle = paste0("Criteria: P < 0.05, |logFC| > 0.5"),
    x        = "Log2 Fold Change (Dead / Alive)",
    y        = "-Log10 P-Value",
    color    = NULL
  ) +
  
  # Theme
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3)))

# ── Version with fixed x-axis ──────────────────────────────────────────────
volcano_plot_clipped <- volcano_plot +
  xlim(-2, 2)   # adjusted from ±2.5 to match new |logFC| > 0.5 scale

# ── Print and save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(volcano_plot)
print(volcano_plot_clipped)

ggsave("volcano_plot_dead_P05_FC05.png",
       plot   = volcano_plot,
       width  = 6, height = 7, dpi = 300)

ggsave("volcano_plot_dead_P05_FC05_clipped.png",
       plot   = volcano_plot_clipped,
       width  = 6, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

#heatmap
```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
de      <- read.csv("DE_results_ComBat_dead.csv")
combat  <- read.csv("combat_counts.csv", row.names = 1)   # samples × miRNAs
metadata <- read.csv("Metadata_Limma_dead_time_all.csv", row.names = 1)

# ── Select significant miRNAs (P < 0.05, |logFC| > 0.5) ──────────────────
sig_mirna <- de %>%
  filter(P.Value < 0.05, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>%
  arrange(P.Value) %>%
  pull(miRNA)

cat("Significant miRNAs:", length(sig_mirna), "\n")

# ── Prepare expression matrix: miRNAs × samples ───────────────────────────
# combat_counts.csv is samples × miRNAs → transpose
expr_mat <- t(combat[, sig_mirna, drop = FALSE])   # miRNA × sample

# Align metadata to sample order in expr_mat
metadata <- metadata[colnames(expr_mat), , drop = FALSE]

# ── Z-score per row (per miRNA) ───────────────────────────────────────────
zscore_mat <- t(scale(t(expr_mat)))   # scale() works on columns → double-transpose

# ── Annotation columns (sample metadata) ─────────────────────────────────
anno_col <- data.frame(
  Status   = ifelse(metadata$dead.status == 1, "Dead", "Alive"),
  Batch    = paste0("Batch ", metadata$Batch),
  row.names = rownames(metadata)
)

# Order samples: Alive first, then Dead (cleaner visual grouping)
sample_order <- c(
  rownames(anno_col)[anno_col$Status == "Alive"],
  rownames(anno_col)[anno_col$Status == "Dead"]
)
zscore_mat <- zscore_mat[, sample_order]
anno_col   <- anno_col[sample_order, , drop = FALSE]

# ── Annotation colors ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
anno_colors <- list(
  Status = c("Alive" = "deepskyblue3", "Dead" = "firebrick"),
  Batch  = c("Batch 1" = "#F0A500", "Batch 2" = "#7B5EA7", "Batch 3" = "#3A9E6F")
)

# ── Clean miRNA row labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Show labels only if <= 30 miRNAs, otherwise hide to avoid crowding
show_rownames <- length(sig_mirna) <= 30

# ── Draw heatmap ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p <- pheatmap(
  mat              = zscore_mat,
  color            = colorRampPalette(c("deepskyblue3", "white", "firebrick"))(100),
  breaks           = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 101),  # cap z-score range at ±2
  
  # Clustering
  cluster_rows     = TRUE,
  cluster_cols     = FALSE,   # FALSE: keep Alive/Dead groups together
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  
  # Annotations
  annotation_col   = anno_col,
  annotation_colors = anno_colors,
  
  # Labels
  show_rownames    = show_rownames,
  show_colnames    = TRUE,
  fontsize_row     = 8,
  fontsize_col     = 7,
  
  # Appearance
  border_color     = NA,
  cellwidth        = 14,
  cellheight       = ifelse(show_rownames, 14, 8),
  
  # Title
  main             = "Differentially expressed miRNA — Dead vs Alive\n(P < 0.05, |logFC| > 0.5, z-score)"
)

# ── Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Auto-size height based on number of miRNAs
plot_height <- max(5, 2 + length(sig_mirna) * 0.25)

ggsave("heatmap_dead_zscore.png",
       plot   = p,
       width  = 10,
       height = plot_height,
       dpi    = 300)

# Also save as PDF for publication
pdf("heatmap_dead_zscore.pdf", width = 10, height = plot_height)
print(p)
dev.off()
```

#uni cox
```{r}
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 1: Load data
# combat_counts.csv: samples × miRNAs, log2 ComBat-corrected.
# Z-scoring is applied BELOW before Cox fitting.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
expr_raw <- read.csv("combat_counts.csv")          # SampleID + miRNA columns
metadata  <- read.csv("Metadata_Limma_dead_time_all.csv", row.names = 1)
de        <- read.csv("DE_results_ComBat_dead.csv")

cat("Samples:", nrow(expr_raw), "\n")
cat("miRNAs: ", ncol(expr_raw) - 1, "\n")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 1.5: Z-score each miRNA across samples
# Applied AFTER log2 ComBat, BEFORE Cox
# scale() works on columns → transpose twice to z-score per miRNA
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
mirna_cols <- setdiff(colnames(expr_raw), "SampleID")
expr_raw[, mirna_cols] <- scale(expr_raw[, mirna_cols])

cat("Z-scoring applied to", length(mirna_cols), "miRNAs\n")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 2: Build survival + expression dataset
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
surv_meta <- metadata %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  transmute(
    SampleID = SampleID,
    time     = as.numeric(Time.Dead),
    status   = as.integer(dead.status)   # 1 = dead, 0 = alive
  )

cox_data <- merge(surv_meta, expr_raw, by = "SampleID")

cat("Events:", sum(cox_data$status), "/", nrow(cox_data),
    " (", round(mean(cox_data$status)*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("Follow-up:", min(cox_data$time), "–", max(cox_data$time), "months\n")

write.csv(cox_data, "zscore_combat_data_for_Cox.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 3: Select candidate miRNAs
# Criteria: P < 0.05 AND |logFC| > 0.5 from DE analysis
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
candidates <- de %>%
  filter(P.Value < 0.05, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>%   # FIXED: was 0.054
  arrange(P.Value) %>%
  pull(miRNA)

candidates <- candidates[candidates %in% colnames(cox_data)]
cat("Candidate miRNAs for univariate Cox:", length(candidates), "\n")

if (length(candidates) == 0) {
  stop("No candidate miRNAs found — check dot vs dash notation in column names.")
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 4: Univariate Cox regression
# β is now in SD units (z-scored) — portable to TCGA
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
surv_obj <- Surv(time = cox_data$time, event = cox_data$status)

results_list <- vector("list", length(candidates))

for (i in seq_along(candidates)) {
  mirna <- candidates[i]

  results_list[[i]] <- tryCatch({
    fit <- coxph(
      as.formula(paste0("surv_obj ~ `", mirna, "`")),
      data = cox_data,
      ties = "efron"
    )
    s <- summary(fit)

    data.frame(
      miRNA        = mirna,
      coef         = s$coefficients[1, "coef"],
      HR           = s$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"],
      HR_lower95   = s$conf.int[1, "lower .95"],
      HR_upper95   = s$conf.int[1, "upper .95"],
      SE           = s$coefficients[1, "se(coef)"],
      z            = s$coefficients[1, "z"],
      p_value      = s$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"],
      concordance  = as.numeric(s$concordance["C"]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("  Skipped ", mirna, ": ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
}

uni_cox <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR       = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    Direction = ifelse(HR > 1, "Risk", "Protective")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

write.csv(uni_cox, "Univariate_Cox_zscore_all.csv", row.names = FALSE)

sig_uni <- uni_cox %>% filter(p_value < 0.05)
write.csv(sig_uni, "Univariate_Cox_zscore_significant.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n─── Univariate Cox results (z-scored ComBat values) ───\n")
cat("Tested:     ", nrow(uni_cox), "\n")
cat("p < 0.05:   ", nrow(sig_uni), "\n")
cat("FDR < 0.05: ", sum(uni_cox$FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    " (note: underpowered with n=34)\n\n")

print(uni_cox %>%
  dplyr::select(miRNA, coef, HR, HR_lower95, HR_upper95, p_value, FDR, concordance) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4))))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 5: Forest plot — FIXED: sig_cox → sig_uni, factor levels fixed
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
plot_data <- sig_uni %>%                           # FIXED: was sig_cox
  mutate(
    label      = gsub("\\.", "-", miRNA),
    label      = factor(label,
                   levels = rev(gsub("\\.", "-", sig_uni$miRNA))),  # FIXED: was uni_cox
    Significant = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, Direction, "Not significant"),
    Significant = factor(Significant,
                   levels = c("Risk", "Protective", "Not significant")),
    annot = paste0("HR=", round(HR, 2),
                   " (", round(HR_lower95, 2), "–", round(HR_upper95, 2), ")",
                   "  p=", formatC(p_value, digits = 1, format = "g"))
  )

ci_cap <- quantile(c(plot_data$HR_lower95, plot_data$HR_upper95), 0.97, na.rm = TRUE)

forest <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = HR, y = label, color = Significant)) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6) +

  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = pmax(HR_lower95, 0.01),
        xmax = pmin(HR_upper95, ci_cap)),
    height = 0.3, linewidth = 0.65
  ) +

  geom_point(size = 3.2, shape = 18) +

  geom_text(
    data = plot_data,
    aes(x     = pmin(HR_upper95, ci_cap) + 0.05,
        y     = label,
        label = annot),
    hjust = 0, size = 2.8, color = "grey20", inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Risk"            = "#B22222",
               "Protective"      = "#1874CD",
               "Not significant" = "grey65"),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    name   = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)  —  z-scored ComBat-corrected expression",
    limits = c(0.25, 6.5),
    trans  = "log10",
    labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  labs(
    title    = "Univariate Cox regression — Overall survival (Dead vs Alive)",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "n = ", nrow(cox_data), " patients  |  ",
      sum(cox_data$status), " events  |  ",
      nrow(sig_uni), " miRNAs p < 0.05",
      "  |  z-scored ComBat-corrected expression"
    ),
    y = NULL, color = NULL
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey93", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 9)
  )

plot_h <- max(5, 1.8 + nrow(plot_data) * 0.30)
ggsave("forestplot_univariate_cox_zscore.png",
       plot = forest, width = 11, height = plot_h, dpi = 300)

print(forest)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 6: Save coefficients for TCGA validation
# β is in SD units — apply to z-scored TCGA log2 expression
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
coef_table <- sig_uni %>%
  dplyr::select(miRNA, coef, HR, HR_lower95, HR_upper95, p_value, concordance) %>%
  mutate(
    miRNA_dash = gsub("\\.", "-", miRNA),
    note = "β from z-scored log2 ComBat Cox; apply to z-scored log2(x+1) TCGA expression"
  )

write.csv(coef_table, "Cox_coefficients_for_validation.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nCoefficient table saved → apply β to z-scored TCGA log2 expression.\n")

ggsave("forestplot_univariate_cox_zscore.pdf", 
       plot = forest, 
       width = 12.5, 
       height = plot_h,
       device = cairo_pdf) # cairo_pdf handles special characters better
```

#forest plot
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(forestplot)
library(grid)

# ── Load & sort ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# UPDATED: load z-scored results
sig_uni <- read.csv("Univariate_Cox_zscore_significant.csv") %>%
  arrange(p_value)

sig_uni$miRNA_display <- gsub("\\.", "-", sig_uni$miRNA)

# ── Clip range ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
clip_lo <- max(0.01, floor(min(sig_uni$HR_lower95, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.8 * 10) / 10)
clip_hi <- min(100,  ceiling(max(sig_uni$HR_upper95, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.2 * 10) / 10)

# ── Label matrix ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
label_text <- rbind(
  c("miRNA", "HR (95% CI)", "P-value"),
  cbind(
    sig_uni$miRNA_display,
    sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", sig_uni$HR, sig_uni$HR_lower95, sig_uni$HR_upper95),
    formatC(sig_uni$p_value, digits = 3, format = "g")
  )
)

# ── Data Vectors ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
hr_vec   <- c(NA, sig_uni$HR)
ci_lower <- c(NA, sig_uni$HR_lower95)
ci_upper <- c(NA, sig_uni$HR_upper95)

# ── Per-row box colors ────────────────────────────────────────────
box_colors <- c(
  "black",
  ifelse(sig_uni$HR > 1, "#B22222", "#1874CD")
)

# ── Shared forestplot arguments ───────────────────────────────────
fp_args <- list(
  labeltext   = label_text,
  mean        = hr_vec,
  lower       = ci_lower,
  upper       = ci_upper,
  is.summary  = c(TRUE, rep(FALSE, nrow(sig_uni))),
  zero        = 1,
  xlog        = TRUE,
  clip        = c(clip_lo, clip_hi),
  # UPDATED: axis label reflects z-scored expression
  xlab        = "Hazard Ratio (log scale) — z-scored log2 ComBat expression",
  boxsize     = 0.25,
  lineheight  = unit(8, "mm"),
  ci.vertices = TRUE,
  ci.vertices.height = 0.15,
  grid        = TRUE,
  col = fpColors(
    box     = box_colors,
    line    = "grey30",
    zero    = "black",
    summary = "black"
  ),
  txt_gp = fpTxtGp(
    label   = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    ticks   = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    xlab    = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    title   = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold")
  ),
  title       = paste0(
    "Univariate Cox — Overall Survival\n",
    "n = events / total  |  z-scored ComBat-corrected expression"
  ),
  colgap      = unit(3, "mm"),
  graphwidth  = unit(60, "mm"),
  align       = c("l", "c", "c")
)

# ── Save PDF ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pdf_h <- max(4, 1.5 + nrow(sig_uni) * 0.4)
pdf("forestplot_univariate_cox_zscore.pdf", width = 10, height = pdf_h)
do.call(forestplot, fp_args)
dev.off()

# ── Save PNG ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
png_h <- max(400, 150 + nrow(sig_uni) * 40)
png("forestplot_univariate_cox_zscore.png", width = 1200, height = png_h, res = 130)
do.call(forestplot, fp_args)
dev.off()

cat("Forest plots saved:\n")
cat("  forestplot_univariate_cox_zscore.pdf\n")
cat("  forestplot_univariate_cox_zscore.png\n")
```

#ROC
```{r}
library(survival)
library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotROC)
library(dplyr)

# ── Load data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# UPDATED: load z-scored merged data
data_wide <- read.csv("Merged_sigCox_zscore_with_metadata.csv")
cox_sig   <- read.csv("Univariate_Cox_zscore_significant.csv") %>%
  arrange(p_value)

sig_mirnas <- cox_sig$miRNA

cat("Samples:", nrow(data_wide), "\n")
cat("miRNAs to plot:", length(sig_mirnas), "\n")

# ── Output folder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dir.create("ROC_plots", showWarnings = FALSE)

# ── Initialise summary table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
roc_summary <- data.frame(
  miRNA       = character(),
  AUC         = numeric(),
  AUC_lower95 = numeric(),
  AUC_upper95 = numeric(),
  sensitivity = numeric(),
  specificity = numeric(),
  cutoff      = numeric(),
  direction   = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ── ROC loop ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for (mirna in sig_mirnas) {

  if (!mirna %in% colnames(data_wide)) {
    message("Skipping — column not found: ", mirna)
    next
  }

  mirna_label <- gsub("\\.", "-", mirna)

  hr_val    <- cox_sig$HR[cox_sig$miRNA == mirna][1]
  direction <- as.character(ifelse(hr_val > 1, "<", ">"))

  if (is.na(direction) || length(direction) != 1) {
    message("Skipping — could not determine direction for: ", mirna)
    next
  }

  # ── Compute ROC ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  roc_obj <- roc(
    response  = data_wide$dead.status,
    predictor = data_wide[[mirna]],
    direction = direction,
    quiet     = TRUE
  )

  auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
  auc_ci  <- ci.auc(roc_obj, conf.level = 0.95)

  best <- coords(roc_obj, "best",
                 ret         = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"),
                 best.method = "youden",
                 transpose   = FALSE)

  ann_text <- sprintf(
    "AUC = %.3f (%.3f\u2013%.3f)\nSensitivity = %.3f\nSpecificity = %.3f\nCut-off = %.3f",
    auc_val, auc_ci[1], auc_ci[3],
    best$sensitivity[1],
    best$specificity[1],
    best$threshold[1]
  )

  # Flip predictor sign for protective miRNAs so curve goes above diagonal
  expr_for_plot <- if (direction == "<") {
    data_wide[[mirna]]
  } else {
    -data_wide[[mirna]]
  }

  roc_df <- data.frame(D = data_wide$dead.status, M = expr_for_plot)

  p <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(m = M, d = D)) +
    geom_roc(n.cuts = 0, labels = FALSE,
             color = "#4A249D", linewidth = 1) +
    style_roc() +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.55, y = 0.25, label = ann_text,
             hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 3.5, color = "black") +
    labs(
      title    = mirna_label,
      subtitle = "z-scored log2 ComBat-corrected expression",   # ADDED
      x        = "1 - Specificity (FPR)",
      y        = "Sensitivity (TPR)"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),  # ADDED
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  outfile <- file.path("ROC_plots",
                       paste0("ROC_zscore_", gsub("\\.", "_", mirna), ".png"))  # UPDATED prefix
  ggsave(outfile, plot = p, width = 5, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

  roc_summary <- rbind(roc_summary, data.frame(
    miRNA       = mirna_label,
    AUC         = round(auc_val, 4),
    AUC_lower95 = round(auc_ci[1], 4),
    AUC_upper95 = round(auc_ci[3], 4),
    sensitivity = round(best$sensitivity[1], 4),
    specificity = round(best$specificity[1], 4),
    cutoff      = round(best$threshold[1], 4),
    direction   = direction,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))

  cat(sprintf("  %s  AUC=%.3f  dir=%s\n", mirna_label, auc_val, direction))
}

# ── Save summary table ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
roc_summary <- roc_summary %>% arrange(desc(AUC))

write.csv(roc_summary,
          "ROC_summary_zscore_sigCox_miRNAs.csv",   # UPDATED filename
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n─── ROC Summary ───\n")
print(roc_summary)
cat("\nAll plots saved to: ROC_plots/\n")
cat("Summary table: ROC_summary_zscore_sigCox_miRNAs.csv\n")
```

#RSF
```{r}
library(randomForestSRC)
options(rf.cores = 1, mc.cores = 1)  # single core: makes VIMP reproducible (matches Table S3)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 1: Load and prepare data
# UPDATED: z-scored ComBat-corrected expression
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
raw <- read.csv("Merged_sigCox_zscore_with_metadata.csv",   # UPDATED
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Option B — Exclude Age (miRNA-only model)
clinical_cols <- c("SampleID", "sex", "smoking", "histo_detail",
                   "stage", "ajcc8_stage", "T", "N", "M",
                   "firstline_detail", "firstline_category", "Batch",
                   "Age")

df <- raw %>%
  select(-any_of(clinical_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    dead.status = as.numeric(dead.status),
    Time.Dead   = as.numeric(Time.Dead)
  )

mirna_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df), c("Time.Dead", "dead.status"))
cat("Samples:         ", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Events:          ", sum(df$dead.status), "\n")
cat("miRNA predictors:", length(mirna_cols), "\n")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 2: RSF
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
set.seed(42)
rsf_model <- rfsrc(
  Surv(Time.Dead, dead.status) ~ .,
  data       = df,
  ntree      = 1000,
  nodesize   = 10,
  mtry       = ceiling(sqrt(length(mirna_cols))),
  importance = TRUE,
  na.action  = "na.impute"
)

saveRDS(rsf_model, "rsf_model_zscore.rds")              # UPDATED filename

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 3: OOB performance
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
oob_error  <- rsf_model$err.rate[rsf_model$ntree]
oob_cindex <- 1 - oob_error

cat("\n─── RSF Performance (OOB) ───\n")
cat("OOB error rate:", round(oob_error,  4), "\n")
cat("OOB C-index:   ", round(oob_cindex, 4), "\n")
cat("(C-index > 0.7 = acceptable; > 0.8 = good)\n")

sink("rsf_model_summary_zscore.txt")                    # UPDATED filename
print(rsf_model)
sink()

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 4: VIMP
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
vimp_df <- data.frame(
  miRNA      = names(rsf_model$importance),
  VIMP       = as.numeric(rsf_model$importance),
  miRNA_dash = gsub("\\.", "-", names(rsf_model$importance))
) %>%
  arrange(desc(VIMP))

write.csv(vimp_df, "rsf_vimp_zscore.csv", row.names = FALSE)   # UPDATED

cat("\n─── Top 10 by VIMP ───\n")
print(head(vimp_df[, c("miRNA_dash", "VIMP")], 10))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 5: Minimal depth
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
set.seed(42)
min_depth <- max.subtree(rsf_model, conservative = FALSE)

depth_df <- data.frame(
  miRNA           = rownames(min_depth$order),
  Minimal_Depth   = min_depth$order[, 1],
  Threshold_Depth = min_depth$order[, 2],
  miRNA_dash      = gsub("\\.", "-", rownames(min_depth$order))
) %>%
  arrange(Minimal_Depth)

threshold_val <- depth_df$Threshold_Depth[1]
cat("\nMinimal depth threshold:", round(threshold_val, 4), "\n")

write.csv(depth_df, "rsf_minimal_depth_zscore.csv", row.names = FALSE)  # UPDATED

cat("\n─── Top 10 by Minimal Depth ───\n")
print(head(depth_df[, c("miRNA_dash", "Minimal_Depth", "Threshold_Depth")], 10))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 6: var.select
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
set.seed(42)
var_sel <- tryCatch(
  randomForestSRC::var.select(object = rsf_model, conservative = "medium"),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

if (is.null(var_sel)) {
  set.seed(42)
  var_sel <- tryCatch(
    randomForestSRC::var.select.rfsrc(rsf_model, conservative = "medium"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

if (is.null(var_sel)) {
  message("var.select unavailable — using manual minimal depth threshold")
  selected_mirnas <- depth_df$miRNA[depth_df$Minimal_Depth <= threshold_val]
} else {
  selected_mirnas <- var_sel$topvars
}

selected_mirnas_dash <- gsub("\\.", "-", selected_mirnas)

cat("\n─── Selected miRNAs ───\n")
cat("n selected:", length(selected_mirnas), "\n")
cat(paste(selected_mirnas_dash, collapse = "\n"), "\n")

write.csv(
  data.frame(miRNA = selected_mirnas, miRNA_dash = selected_mirnas_dash),
  "rsf_selected_mirnas_zscore.csv", row.names = FALSE          # UPDATED
)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 7: Merge VIMP + minimal depth summary
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
summary_df <- merge(
  vimp_df  %>% select(miRNA, miRNA_dash, VIMP),
  depth_df %>% select(miRNA, Minimal_Depth, Threshold_Depth),
  by = "miRNA", all = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(Selected_by_varSelect = miRNA %in% selected_mirnas) %>%
  arrange(Minimal_Depth)

write.csv(summary_df,
          "rsf_summary_vimp_mindepth_zscore.csv",              # UPDATED
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n─── Combined summary (top 15) ───\n")
print(head(summary_df[,
  c("miRNA_dash", "VIMP", "Minimal_Depth", "Selected_by_varSelect")], 15))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 8: Plots
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Plot A: VIMP ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_vimp <- vimp_df %>%
  mutate(
    miRNA_dash = factor(miRNA_dash, levels = rev(miRNA_dash)),
    positive   = VIMP >= 0
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = VIMP, y = miRNA_dash, fill = positive)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#B22222", "FALSE" = "#94a3b8"),
                    guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title    = "RSF Variable Importance (VIMP)",
    subtitle = paste0("n=", nrow(df), "  |  OOB C-index = ",
                      round(oob_cindex, 3),
                      "  |  z-scored ComBat expression"),   # UPDATED
    x        = "VIMP (positive = important)",
    y        = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 9))

ggsave("rsf_vimp_plot_zscore.png", p_vimp,                    # UPDATED
       width = 7, height = max(4, 1.2 + nrow(vimp_df) * 0.28), dpi = 300)

# ── Plot B: Minimal depth ─────────────────────────────────────────
p_depth <- depth_df %>%
  mutate(
    miRNA_dash = factor(miRNA_dash, levels = rev(miRNA_dash)),
    selected   = miRNA %in% selected_mirnas
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Minimal_Depth, y = miRNA_dash, color = selected)) +

  geom_segment(aes(x    = min(depth_df$Minimal_Depth) * 0.95,
                   xend = Minimal_Depth,
                   yend = miRNA_dash),
               linewidth = 0.7) +

  geom_point(size = 3) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = threshold_val,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.6) +

  annotate("text", x = threshold_val, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("threshold = ", round(threshold_val, 3)),
           hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 3, color = "firebrick") +

  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE"  = "#B22222",
                                 "FALSE" = "#94a3b8"),
                     labels = c("Not selected",
                                 "Selected by var.select"),
                     name   = NULL) +

  labs(
    title    = "RSF Minimal Depth",
    subtitle = paste0("z-scored ComBat expression  |  ",   # UPDATED
                      "Red dashed = selection threshold"),
    x        = "Minimal depth (smaller = more important)",
    y        = NULL
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),
        legend.position  = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 9))

ggsave("rsf_minimal_depth_plot_zscore.png", p_depth,           # UPDATED
       width = 7, height = max(4, 1.2 + nrow(depth_df) * 0.28), dpi = 300)

cat("\n═══ RSF complete ═══\n")
cat("  rsf_model_zscore.rds                  ← reload with readRDS()\n")
cat("  rsf_selected_mirnas_zscore.csv        → input for LASSO Cox\n")
cat("  rsf_summary_vimp_mindepth_zscore.csv\n")
cat("  rsf_vimp_plot_zscore.png\n")
cat("  rsf_minimal_depth_plot_zscore.png\n")
cat("  OOB C-index:", round(oob_cindex, 3), "\n")
```


#top borda score selected
```{r}
library(randomForestSRC)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ── Load RSF results ───────────────────────────────────────────────
summary_df <- read.csv("rsf_summary_vimp_mindepth_zscore.csv")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# RANK EACH METRIC + BORDA SCORE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ranked <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(
    Rank_VIMP     = rank(-VIMP, ties.method = "min"),
    Rank_MD       = rank(Minimal_Depth, ties.method = "min"),
    VIMP_positive = VIMP > 0,
    Borda_Score   = (Rank_VIMP + Rank_MD) / 2,
    Borda_Rank    = rank(Borda_Score, ties.method = "min")
  ) %>%
  arrange(Borda_Score)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SELECT miRNAs WITH BORDA SCORE < 6
# Excludes the tied pair (miR-30b-5p and miR-1268b, both Borda = 6)
# Gives 4 unambiguous candidates
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
selected <- ranked %>%
  filter(
    VIMP_positive == TRUE,
    Borda_Score   <  6        # strict cutoff — excludes Borda = 6 tie
  ) %>%
  arrange(Borda_Score)

cat("=== SELECTED miRNAs (Borda < 6) ===\n")
cat("n selected:", nrow(selected), "\n\n")

print(selected %>%
  select(miRNA_dash, VIMP, Rank_VIMP,
         Minimal_Depth, Rank_MD, Borda_Score))

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ranked %>%
  select(miRNA_dash, VIMP, Rank_VIMP,
         Minimal_Depth, Rank_MD,
         Borda_Score, Borda_Rank, VIMP_positive) %>%
  write.csv("rsf_full_ranking_borda_zscore.csv", row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(
  selected %>%
    select(miRNA = miRNA_dash, VIMP, Rank_VIMP,
           Minimal_Depth, Rank_MD, Borda_Score),
  "rsf_top4_borda_zscore.csv",                    # reflects 4 miRNAs
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PLOT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
plot_df <- ranked %>%
  mutate(
    Label_group = case_when(
      miRNA_dash %in% selected$miRNA_dash ~ "Selected (Borda < 6)",
      VIMP_positive & Borda_Score == 6   ~ "Excluded (Borda = 6 tie)",
      VIMP_positive                      ~ "Positive VIMP",
      TRUE                               ~ "Negative VIMP (noise)"
    ),
    Label_group = factor(Label_group,
                         levels = c("Selected (Borda < 6)",
                                    "Excluded (Borda = 6 tie)",
                                    "Positive VIMP",
                                    "Negative VIMP (noise)"))
  )

p_rank <- ggplot(plot_df,
                 aes(x = Rank_MD, y = Rank_VIMP, color = Label_group)) +

  # Selection zone
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 6.5,
                   ymin = 0.5, ymax = 6.5,
           fill = "#FFF0F0", alpha = 0.45) +
  annotate("text", x = 6.4, y = 0.8,
           label = "Borda < 6\n(selected)",
           hjust = 1, size = 3,
           color = "#B22222", fontface = "italic") +

  geom_point(aes(size = 1 / Borda_Score), alpha = 0.85) +

  # Label selected 4
  geom_label_repel(
    data          = filter(plot_df, Label_group == "Selected (Borda < 6)"),
    aes(label     = miRNA_dash),
    size          = 3,
    fontface      = "bold",
    color         = "grey10",
    fill          = "#FFF0F0",
    box.padding   = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey60",
    segment.size  = 0.3,
    show.legend   = FALSE
  ) +

  # Label excluded tie pair
  geom_label_repel(
    data          = filter(plot_df,
                           Label_group == "Excluded (Borda = 6 tie)"),
    aes(label     = miRNA_dash),
    size          = 2.8,
    color         = "grey40",
    fill          = "#FFFBF0",
    box.padding   = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey70",
    segment.size  = 0.3,
    show.legend   = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Selected (Borda < 6)"      = "#B22222",
               "Excluded (Borda = 6 tie)"  = "#A8A8A8",
               "Positive VIMP"             = "#A8A8A8",
               "Negative VIMP (noise)"     = "#D0D0D0"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7), guide = "none") +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:nrow(ranked),
                     name   = "Minimal depth rank (1 = lowest = best)") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:nrow(ranked),
                     name   = "VIMP rank (1 = highest = best)") +

  labs(
    title    = "RSF candidate selection — Borda score < 6",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Borda = (Rank_VIMP + Rank_MD) / 2  |  ",
      "4 unambiguous candidates selected  |  ",
      "Borda = 6 tie excluded  |  ",
      "z-scored ComBat expression"
    )
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave("rsf_top4_borda_plot_zscore.png",
       p_rank, width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 300)
print(p_rank)

cat("\n4 selected miRNAs for LASSO Cox:\n")
cat(paste0("  ", selected$miRNA_dash, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
cat("\nSaved: rsf_full_ranking_borda_zscore.csv\n")
cat("Saved: rsf_top4_borda_zscore.csv          → input for LASSO Cox\n")
cat("Saved: rsf_top4_borda_plot_zscore.png\n")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

# ── Load data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df       <- read.csv("rsf_full_ranking_borda_zscore.csv")   # UPDATED
selected <- read.csv("rsf_top4_borda_zscore.csv")           # UPDATED

selected_mirnas <- selected$miRNA

# ── Color scheme ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
col_selected  <- "#B22222"   # red        — Borda < 6 selected
col_excluded  <- "#94a3b8"   # amber      — Borda = 6 tie excluded
col_other_pos <- "#94a3b8"   # grey-blue  — positive VIMP, not selected
col_neg       <- "#CBD5E1"   # light grey — negative VIMP

# ── Shared color classification ───────────────────────────────────
add_color_group <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      Color = case_when(
        miRNA_dash %in% selected_mirnas         ~ "Selected (Borda < 6)",
        VIMP_positive & Borda_Score == 6        ~ "Excluded (Borda = 6 tie)",
        VIMP_positive                           ~ "Positive VIMP",
        TRUE                                    ~ "Negative VIMP (noise)"
      ),
      Color = factor(Color,
                     levels = c("Selected (Borda < 6)",
                                "Excluded (Borda = 6 tie)",
                                "Positive VIMP",
                                "Negative VIMP (noise)"))
    )
}

color_values <- c(
  "Selected (Borda < 6)"     = col_selected,
  "Excluded (Borda = 6 tie)" = col_excluded,
  "Positive VIMP"            = col_other_pos,
  "Negative VIMP (noise)"    = col_neg
)

# ── Thresholds ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# VIMP value at the boundary of selected vs excluded
vimp_threshold <- df %>%
  filter(miRNA_dash %in% selected_mirnas) %>%
  slice_min(VIMP, n = 1) %>%
  pull(VIMP)

md_threshold <- df %>%
  filter(miRNA_dash %in% selected_mirnas) %>%
  slice_max(Minimal_Depth, n = 1) %>%
  pull(Minimal_Depth)

n_total <- nrow(df)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL A: VIMP lollipop
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
vimp_order <- df %>%
  add_color_group() %>%
  arrange(VIMP) %>%
  mutate(miRNA_dash = factor(miRNA_dash, levels = miRNA_dash))

pA <- ggplot(vimp_order, aes(x = VIMP, y = miRNA_dash, color = Color)) +

  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = VIMP, yend = miRNA_dash),
               linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +

  # Selection boundary
  geom_vline(xintercept = vimp_threshold,
             linetype = "dashed", color = col_selected,
             linewidth = 0.6) +

  annotate("text",
           x = vimp_threshold, y = Inf,
           label = "",
           hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.3,
           size = 2.8, color = col_selected) +

  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", VIMP),
        x     = ifelse(VIMP >= 0, VIMP + 0.0009, VIMP - 0.0009),
        hjust = ifelse(VIMP >= 0, 0, 1)),
    size = 2.5, color = "grey30"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = color_values, name = NULL) +

  labs(
    title    = "A   Variable importance (VIMP)",
    subtitle = "Ordered by VIMP  |  Dashed = Borda < 6 selection boundary",
    x        = "VIMP (positive = important, negative = noise)",
    y        = NULL
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 8.5)
  )
print(pA)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL B: Minimal depth lollipop
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
md_order <- df %>%
  add_color_group() %>%
  arrange(desc(Minimal_Depth)) %>%
  mutate(miRNA_dash = factor(miRNA_dash, levels = miRNA_dash))

pB <- ggplot(md_order, aes(x = Minimal_Depth, y = miRNA_dash, color = Color)) + 
  
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Minimal_Depth),
        x     = Minimal_Depth + 0.005), # Offset to the right
    hjust = 0, 
    size  = 2.5, 
    color = "grey30"
  ) +

  geom_segment(aes(x    = min(df$Minimal_Depth) * 0.97,
                   xend = Minimal_Depth,
                   yend = miRNA_dash),
               linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = md_threshold,
             linetype = "dashed", color = col_selected,
             linewidth = 0.6) +

  annotate("text",
           x = md_threshold, y = Inf,
           label = "",
           hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.2,
           size = 2.8, color = col_selected) +

  scale_color_manual(values = color_values, name = NULL) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(min(df$Minimal_Depth) * 0.96,
               max(df$Minimal_Depth) * 1.06)
  ) +

  labs(
    title    = "B   Minimal depth",
    subtitle = "Ordered by minimal depth  |  Dashed = Borda < 6 selection boundary",
    x        = "Minimal depth (smaller = splits earlier = more important)",
    y        = NULL
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 8.5)
  )

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL C: Borda score scatter
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
scatter_df <- df %>% add_color_group()

pC <- ggplot(scatter_df, aes(x = Rank_MD, y = Rank_VIMP, color = Color)) +

  # Selection zone — Borda < 6 corresponds roughly to rank sum < 12
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = 0.5, xmax = 6.5,
           ymin = 0.5, ymax = 6.5,
           fill = "#FFF0F0", alpha = 0.55) +
  annotate("text",
           x = 6.4, y = 6.4,
           label = "",
           hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
           size = 2.8, color = col_selected, fontface = "italic") +

  # Borda = 6 boundary lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = 6.5,
             linetype = "dashed", color = col_selected,
             linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 6.5,
             linetype = "dashed", color = col_selected,
             linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +

  geom_point(aes(size = 1 / Borda_Score), alpha = 0.9) +

  # Label selected 4 — bold
  geom_label_repel(
    data          = filter(scatter_df, Color == "Selected (Borda < 6)"),
    aes(label     = miRNA_dash),
    size          = 2.8,
    fontface      = "bold",
    color         = "grey10",
    fill          = "#FFF0F0",
    box.padding   = 0.45,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey60",
    segment.size  = 0.3,
    max.overlaps  = 20,
    show.legend   = FALSE
  ) +

  # Label excluded tie pair
  geom_label_repel(
    data          = filter(scatter_df,
                           Color == "Excluded (Borda = 6 tie)"),
    aes(label     = miRNA_dash),
    size          = 2.5,
    color         = "grey30",
    fill          = "#FFFBF0",
    box.padding   = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey70",
    segment.size  = 0.3,
    show.legend   = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = color_values, name = NULL) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7), guide = "none") +

  scale_x_continuous(name   = "Minimal depth rank (1 = lowest = best)",
                     breaks = seq(1, n_total, by = 1),
                     limits = c(0.5, n_total + 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name   = "VIMP rank (1 = highest = best)",
                     breaks = 1:n_total,
                     limits = c(0.5, n_total + 0.5)) +

  labs(
    title    = "C   Borda score — candidate selection",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Borda = (Rank_VIMP + Rank_MD) / 2  |  ",
      "4 miRNAs with Borda < 6 selected  |  ",
      "Borda = 6 tie excluded"
    )
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +

  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)))

print(pC)
```

#LASSO Cox script
```{r}
library(survival)
library(glmnet)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 1: Load data — 4 Borda-selected RSF candidates
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cox_data <- read.csv("zscore_combat_data_for_Cox.csv")

# UPDATED: load Borda top 4
rsf_selected <- read.csv("rsf_top4_borda_zscore.csv")

# Convert dash → dot notation to match column names in cox_data
final_mirnas <- gsub("-", ".", rsf_selected$miRNA)

# Confirm all present
final_mirnas <- final_mirnas[final_mirnas %in% colnames(cox_data)]
cat("Confirmed miRNAs in data:", length(final_mirnas), "\n")
cat(paste(" ", gsub("\\.", "-", final_mirnas), collapse = "\n"), "\n")

# Survival matrix
X <- as.matrix(cox_data[, final_mirnas])
y <- Surv(time = cox_data$time, event = cox_data$status)

cat("\nSamples:", nrow(X), "| Events:", sum(cox_data$status), "\n")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 2: LASSO Cox — 10-fold cross-validation
# Only 4 input variables — LASSO may retain 2-4
# lambda.1se enforces maximum parsimony
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
set.seed(42)
cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(
  x      = X,
  y      = y,
  family = "cox",
  alpha  = 1,        # 1 = LASSO
  nfolds = 10,
  maxit  = 10000
)

cat("\n─── LASSO Cross-Validation ───\n")
cat("lambda.min:", round(cv_lasso$lambda.min, 6), "\n")
cat("lambda.1se:", round(cv_lasso$lambda.1se, 6), "\n")

# Extract coefficients at both lambdas
coef_1se <- coef(cv_lasso, s = "lambda.1se")
coef_min <- coef(cv_lasso, s = "lambda.min")

selected_1se <- rownames(coef_1se)[coef_1se[, 1] != 0]
selected_min <- rownames(coef_min)[coef_min[, 1] != 0]

cat("\nSelected at lambda.1se (", length(selected_1se), "):",
    paste(gsub("\\.", "-", selected_1se), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Selected at lambda.min (", length(selected_min), "):",
    paste(gsub("\\.", "-", selected_min), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ── Save LASSO coefficient table ──────────────────────────────────
lasso_coef_df <- data.frame(
  miRNA      = final_mirnas,
  miRNA_dash = gsub("\\.", "-", final_mirnas),
  coef_1se   = as.numeric(coef_1se[final_mirnas, 1]),
  coef_min   = as.numeric(coef_min[final_mirnas, 1])
) %>%
  mutate(
    selected_1se = coef_1se != 0,
    selected_min = coef_min != 0
  )

write.csv(lasso_coef_df,
          "LASSO_Cox_coefficients_borda_zscore.csv",          # UPDATED
          row.names = FALSE)
print(lasso_coef_df)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 3: LASSO diagnostic plots
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
pdf("LASSO_diagnostics_borda_zscore.pdf",                     # UPDATED
    width = 11, height = 5)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

plot(cv_lasso,
     main = "LASSO Cox — CV partial likelihood deviance")
abline(v = log(cv_lasso$lambda.min), lty = 2, col = "red",  lwd = 1.5)
abline(v = log(cv_lasso$lambda.1se), lty = 2, col = "blue", lwd = 1.5)
legend("topleft",
       legend = c("lambda.min", "lambda.1se"),
       col    = c("red", "blue"), lty = 2, cex = 0.85)

plot(cv_lasso$glmnet.fit, xvar = "lambda",
     main = "LASSO Cox — coefficient path")
abline(v = log(cv_lasso$lambda.min), lty = 2, col = "red",  lwd = 1.5)
abline(v = log(cv_lasso$lambda.1se), lty = 2, col = "blue", lwd = 1.5)

dev.off()

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 4: Multivariate Cox on LASSO-selected miRNAs
# Use lambda.1se — fall back to lambda.min if empty
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
model_mirnas <- if (length(selected_1se) > 0) selected_1se else selected_min

if (length(model_mirnas) == 0) {
  stop("LASSO selected 0 variables. Try alpha = 0.5 (ElasticNet).")
}

cat("\n─── Multivariate Cox on LASSO-selected miRNAs ───\n")
cat("Using:", paste(gsub("\\.", "-", model_mirnas), collapse = ", "), "\n")

formula_str <- paste0(
  "y ~ `", paste(model_mirnas, collapse = "` + `"), "`"
)

multi_cox     <- coxph(as.formula(formula_str),
                        data = cox_data, ties = "efron")
multi_summary <- summary(multi_cox)

# ── Results table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
multi_results <- data.frame(
  miRNA      = model_mirnas,
  miRNA_dash = gsub("\\.", "-", model_mirnas),
  coef       = multi_summary$coefficients[, "coef"],
  HR         = multi_summary$conf.int[,  "exp(coef)"],
  HR_lower95 = multi_summary$conf.int[,  "lower .95"],
  HR_upper95 = multi_summary$conf.int[,  "upper .95"],
  SE         = multi_summary$coefficients[, "se(coef)"],
  z          = multi_summary$coefficients[, "z"],
  p_value    = multi_summary$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
)

cat("\n")
print(multi_results[, c("miRNA_dash", "coef", "HR",
                         "HR_lower95", "HR_upper95", "p_value")])
cat("\nMultivariate Cox C-index:",
    round(multi_summary$concordance["C"], 3), "\n")
cat("Model p-value (LRT):     ",
    round(multi_summary$logtest["pvalue"], 4), "\n")

write.csv(multi_results,
          "Multivariate_Cox_results_borda_zscore.csv",        # UPDATED
          row.names = FALSE)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 5: Forest plot
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
forest_df <- multi_results %>%
  mutate(
    miRNA_dash = factor(miRNA_dash, levels = rev(miRNA_dash)),
    Direction  = ifelse(HR > 1, "Risk (HR > 1)", "Protective (HR < 1)"),
    annot      = sprintf("HR = %.2f (%.1f\u2013%.1f)   p = %s",
                          HR, HR_lower95, HR_upper95,
                          formatC(p_value, digits = 1, format = "g"))
  )

ci_cap <- max(forest_df$HR_upper95) * 1.3

forest_plot <- ggplot(forest_df,
                      aes(x = HR, y = miRNA_dash, color = Direction)) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6) +

  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = pmax(HR_lower95, 0.01),
                     xmax = pmin(HR_upper95, ci_cap)),
                 height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8) +

  geom_point(size = 4, shape = 18) +

  geom_text(aes(x = pmin(HR_upper95, ci_cap), label = annot),
            hjust = -0.05, size = 3, color = "grey20") +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Risk (HR > 1)"       = "#B22222",
               "Protective (HR < 1)" = "#1874CD"),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    name   = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI) — log scale  |  z-scored expression",
    trans  = "log10",
    limits = c(0.2, ci_cap * 3),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  labs(
    title    = "Multivariate Cox regression — final model",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "4 Borda-selected RSF candidates → LASSO Cox → ", # UPDATED
      length(model_mirnas), " variables  |  ",
      "C-index = ", round(multi_summary$concordance["C"], 3),
      "  |  n = 34, 18 events  |  z-scored ComBat expression"
    ),
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 10)
  )


print(forest_plot)

ggsave("forestplot_multivariate_cox_borda_zscore.png",        # UPDATED
       forest_plot,
       width  = 8,
       height = max(3, 1.5 + length(model_mirnas) * 0.6),
       dpi    = 300)



# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 6: Save β coefficients for risk score + TCGA validation
# β is in SD units — apply to z-scored log2(x+1) TCGA expression
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
beta_table <- multi_results %>%
  select(miRNA, miRNA_dash, coef, HR,
         HR_lower95, HR_upper95, p_value) %>%
  mutate(note = paste0(
    "Beta from multivariate Cox (z-scored ComBat); ",
    "apply to z-scored log2(x+1) TCGA expression"
  ))

write.csv(beta_table,
          "Final_Cox_betas_for_risk_score_borda_zscore.csv",  # UPDATED
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n═══ Complete ═══\n")
cat("Files saved:\n")
cat("  LASSO_Cox_coefficients_borda_zscore.csv\n")
cat("  LASSO_diagnostics_borda_zscore.pdf\n")
cat("  Multivariate_Cox_results_borda_zscore.csv\n")
cat("  Final_Cox_betas_for_risk_score_borda_zscore.csv  ← use for risk score + TCGA\n")
cat("  forestplot_multivariate_cox_borda_zscore.png\n")
cat("\nNext step: build risk score using Final_Cox_betas_for_risk_score_borda_zscore.csv\n")
```


#ROC
```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(timeROC)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 1: Load data and β coefficients
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cox_data <- read.csv("zscore_combat_data_for_Cox.csv")            # UPDATED
betas    <- read.csv("Final_Cox_betas_for_risk_score_borda_zscore.csv") # UPDATED

sig_mirnas <- betas$miRNA   # dot-notation — 3 LASSO-selected miRNAs

cat("Signature miRNAs (3-miRNA signature):\n")                    # UPDATED
cat(paste(" ", betas$miRNA_dash, "β =", round(betas$coef, 4),
          collapse = "\n"), "\n")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 2: Compute risk score
# Risk = Σ (β_i × z_scored_expression_i)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
expr_mat   <- as.matrix(cox_data[, sig_mirnas])
beta_vec   <- betas$coef

risk_score <- as.numeric(expr_mat %*% beta_vec)

risk_df <- cox_data %>%
  select(SampleID, time, status) %>%
  mutate(
    RiskScore = risk_score,
    RiskGroup = ifelse(RiskScore >= median(RiskScore), "High", "Low"),
    RiskGroup = factor(RiskGroup, levels = c("Low", "High"))
  )

cat("\nRisk score range:", round(min(risk_score), 3),
    "to", round(max(risk_score), 3), "\n")
cat("Median cutoff:   ", round(median(risk_score), 3), "\n")
cat("High risk: n =", sum(risk_df$RiskGroup == "High"),
    "| Low risk: n =", sum(risk_df$RiskGroup == "Low"), "\n")
cat("High risk events:", sum(risk_df$status[risk_df$RiskGroup == "High"]),
    "| Low risk events:", sum(risk_df$status[risk_df$RiskGroup == "Low"]), "\n")

write.csv(risk_df, "RiskScore_results_borda_zscore.csv",          # UPDATED
          row.names = FALSE)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 3: Kaplan-Meier survival curve
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
surv_obj <- Surv(time = risk_df$time, event = risk_df$status)
km_fit   <- survfit(surv_obj ~ RiskGroup, data = risk_df)

logrank  <- survdiff(surv_obj ~ RiskGroup, data = risk_df)
lr_pval  <- 1 - pchisq(logrank$chisq, df = 1)

cat("\nLog-rank p-value:", round(lr_pval, 4), "\n")

km_plot <- ggsurvplot(
  km_fit,
  data          = risk_df,
  palette       = c("#1874CD", "#B22222"),
  linetype      = c("solid", "solid"),
  size          = 0.9,

  pval          = FALSE,          # UPDATED: turn off auto p-val — shown in subtitle

  conf.int       = TRUE,
  conf.int.alpha = 0.12,

  risk.table          = TRUE,
  risk.table.height   = 0.28,
  risk.table.fontsize = 3.5,
  tables.theme        = theme_cleantable(),

  censor.shape = "|",
  censor.size  = 3.5,

  legend.labs  = c("Low risk", "High risk"),
  legend.title = "Risk group",
  xlab         = "Time (months)",
  ylab         = "Overall survival probability",

  title    = "Kaplan-Meier — 3-miRNA prognostic signature",
  subtitle = paste0(                                              # UPDATED
    "hsa-miR-509-3p + hsa-miR-377-3p \u2212 hsa-miR-378h  |  ",
    "n = 34, 18 events  |  median risk score cutoff  |  ",
    "Log-rank p = ", formatC(lr_pval, digits = 3, format = "g") # p-value here
  ),

  xlim             = c(0, max(risk_df$time) + 1),
  break.time.by    = 6,
  surv.median.line = "hv",

  ggtheme = theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),
      legend.position = c(0.82, 0.82)
    )
)

# REMOVED: annotate() block — p-value now in subtitle

png("KM_curve_risk_groups_borda_zscore.png",
    width = 2400, height = 2100, res = 300)
print(km_plot)
dev.off()

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 4: Risk score distribution plot
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
risk_df_ord <- risk_df %>%
  arrange(RiskScore) %>%
  mutate(Patient_idx = row_number())

p_score <- ggplot(risk_df_ord,
                  aes(x = Patient_idx, y = RiskScore,
                      color = RiskGroup, shape = factor(status))) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = median(risk_score),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +

  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c("Low" = "#1874CD", "High" = "#B22222"),
                     name = "Risk group") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("0" = 1, "1" = 16),
                     labels = c("0" = "Alive (censored)", "1" = "Dead"),
                     name = "Status") +

  annotate("text",
           x = 1, y = median(risk_score) + 0.02,
           label = paste0(),
           hjust = 0, size = 3, color = "grey30") +

  labs(
    title    = "Risk score distribution",
    subtitle = "Sorted by risk score  |  Dashed = median cutoff  |  z-scored expression",
    x        = "Patients (sorted by risk score)",
    y        = "Risk score"
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 5: Survival status heatmap strip
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
status_tile <- risk_df_ord %>%
  mutate(status_label = ifelse(status == 1, "Dead", "Alive"))

p_tile <- ggplot(status_tile,
                 aes(x = Patient_idx, y = 1, fill = status_label)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Dead" = "#B22222", "Alive" = "#1874CD"),
                    name = "Survival") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 17.5,
             color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Status") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text       = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks      = element_blank(),
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin     = margin(0, 5, 0, 5)
  )

combined_score <- p_score / p_tile +
  plot_layout(heights = c(4, 0.5)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Risk score distribution and survival status",
    subtitle = paste0(                                             # UPDATED
      "Risk = 0.743 \u00d7 hsa-miR-509-3p ",
      "+ 0.503 \u00d7 hsa-miR-377-3p ",
      "\u2212 0.663 \u00d7 hsa-miR-378h"
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9)
    )
  )

ggsave("RiskScore_distribution_borda_zscore.png",                 # UPDATED
       combined_score, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 6: Time-dependent ROC
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
troc <- timeROC(
  T      = risk_df$time,
  delta  = risk_df$status,
  marker = risk_df$RiskScore,
  cause  = 1,
  times  = c(6, 12, 18),
  iid    = TRUE
)

auc_df <- data.frame(
  Timepoint = c(6, 12, 18),
  AUC       = as.numeric(troc$AUC),
  AUC_lower = as.numeric(troc$AUC) - 1.96 *
              as.numeric(troc$inference$vect_sd_1),
  AUC_upper = as.numeric(troc$AUC) + 1.96 *
              as.numeric(troc$inference$vect_sd_1)
)

cat("\n─── Time-dependent ROC AUC ───\n")
print(auc_df)
write.csv(auc_df,
          "TimeROC_AUC_borda_zscore.csv",                        # UPDATED
          row.names = FALSE)

# ── ROC curves ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
roc_plot_df <- data.frame(
  FPR  = c(troc$FP[, 1], troc$FP[, 2], troc$FP[, 3]),
  TPR  = c(troc$TP[, 1], troc$TP[, 2], troc$TP[, 3]),
  Time = rep(paste0(c(6, 12, 18), " months"), each = nrow(troc$FP))
)

auc_labels <- paste0(
  c(6, 12, 18), " months  AUC = ",
  round(auc_df$AUC, 3),
  " (", round(auc_df$AUC_lower, 3),
  "\u2013", round(auc_df$AUC_upper, 3), ")"
)
names(auc_labels) <- paste0(c(6, 12, 18), " months")

p_roc <- ggplot(roc_plot_df,
                aes(x = FPR, y = TPR, color = Time)) +

  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("6 months"  = "#B22222",
               "12 months" = "#E88B00",
               "18 months" = "#1874CD"),
    labels = auc_labels,
    name   = NULL
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(name = "1 - Specificity (FPR)",
                     limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Sensitivity (TPR)",
                     limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +

  labs(
    title    = "Time-dependent ROC — 3-miRNA risk score",        # UPDATED
    subtitle = "Cause-specific AUC with 95% CI  |  Blanche et al. method"
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position   = c(0.62, 0.18),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80"),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle     = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    aspect.ratio      = 1
  )

ggsave("TimeROC_curves_borda_zscore.png",                        # UPDATED
       p_roc, width = 9, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
print(p_roc)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 7: Summary
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cat("\n═══ Risk score analysis complete ═══\n")
cat("\n3-miRNA risk score formula:\n")                            # UPDATED
cat("  Risk = 0.743 × hsa-miR-509-3p\n")
cat("       + 0.503 × hsa-miR-377-3p\n")
cat("       - 0.663 × hsa-miR-378h\n")
cat("\nLog-rank p-value:", round(lr_pval, 4), "\n")
cat("Time-ROC AUC:\n")
for (i in 1:nrow(auc_df)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %2d months: %.3f (%.3f\u2013%.3f)\n",
              auc_df$Timepoint[i],
              auc_df$AUC[i],
              auc_df$AUC_lower[i],
              auc_df$AUC_upper[i]))
}
cat("\nFiles saved:\n")
cat("  RiskScore_results_borda_zscore.csv\n")
cat("  KM_curve_risk_groups_borda_zscore.png\n")
cat("  RiskScore_distribution_borda_zscore.png\n")
cat("  TimeROC_curves_borda_zscore.png\n")
cat("  TimeROC_AUC_borda_zscore.csv\n")
```

#improved KM
```{r}
# ── 3-miRNA KM plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────
surv_obj <- Surv(time = risk_df$time, event = risk_df$status)
km_fit   <- survfit(surv_obj ~ RiskGroup, data = risk_df)
logrank  <- survdiff(surv_obj ~ RiskGroup, data = risk_df)
lr_pval  <- 1 - pchisq(logrank$chisq, df = 1)

# ── Compute HR for risk group (High vs Low) dynamically ───────────
# Do NOT hardcode — recompute from actual data
hr_model   <- coxph(surv_obj ~ RiskGroup, data = risk_df)
hr_summary <- summary(hr_model)
hr_val     <- hr_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
hr_lo      <- hr_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
hr_hi      <- hr_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]

cat("Risk group HR (High vs Low):",
    round(hr_val, 2),
    "(", round(hr_lo, 2), "-", round(hr_hi, 2), ")\n")
cat("Log-rank p:", round(lr_pval, 4), "\n")

km_plot <- ggsurvplot(
  km_fit,
  data    = risk_df,
  palette = c("#1874CD", "#B22222"),
  size    = 0.9,

  # P-value — turn off auto, shown in annotate below
  pval   = FALSE,

  # Confidence interval
  conf.int       = TRUE,
  conf.int.alpha = 0.12,

  # Risk table
  risk.table          = TRUE,
  risk.table.height   = 0.28,
  risk.table.fontsize = 5,
  risk.table.y.text   = FALSE,
  tables.theme        = theme_cleantable(),

  # Censoring
  censor.shape = "|",
  censor.size  = 4,

  # Median lines
  surv.median.line = "hv",

  # Legend
  legend.labs  = c("Low risk  (n=17)", "High risk  (n=17)"),
  legend.title = "",

  # Axes
  xlab          = "Time (months)",
  ylab          = "Overall survival probability",
  xlim          = c(0, 30),
  break.time.by = 6,
  ylim          = c(0, 1.02),

  # Title — UPDATED: 3-miRNA
  title = "Kaplan-Meier — 3-miRNA prognostic signature",

  ggtheme = theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.subtitle     = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9),
      legend.position   = c(0.80, 0.82),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill  = "white",
                                       color = "grey80",
                                       linewidth = 0.4)
    )
)

# ── HR + p-value annotation — UPDATED: dynamic values ─────────────
km_plot$plot <- km_plot$plot +
  annotate("text",
           x     = -1.3, y = 0.1,
           label = paste0(
             "HR = ", round(hr_val, 2),
             " (", round(hr_lo, 2),
             "\u2013", round(hr_hi, 2), ")\n",
             "Log-rank p = ",
             formatC(lr_pval, digits = 2, format = "g")
           ),
           hjust = 0, size = 3.4, color = "grey20") +
  labs(
    subtitle = paste0(                                  # UPDATED subtitle
      "hsa-miR-509-3p + hsa-miR-377-3p \u2212 hsa-miR-378h  |  ",
      "z-scored ComBat expression  |  median risk score cutoff"
    )
  )

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
png("KM_curve_risk_groups_borda_zscore.png",
    width = 2400, height = 2100, res = 300)
print(km_plot)
dev.off()

pdf("KM_curve_risk_groups_borda_zscore.pdf",
    width = 8, height = 7)
print(km_plot)
dev.off()

cat("KM plot saved\n")
```

#multi clinical 
```{r}
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(forestplot)
library(ggrepel)
library(grid)

select    <- dplyr::select
filter    <- dplyr::filter
mutate    <- dplyr::mutate
rename    <- dplyr::rename
left_join <- dplyr::left_join

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 1: Load data
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
metadata <- read.csv("Metadata_Limma_dead_time_all.csv")
risk_df  <- read.csv("RiskScore_results_borda_zscore.csv")     # UPDATED

clin <- metadata %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(risk_df, SampleID, RiskScore, RiskGroup),
            by = "SampleID") %>%
  mutate(
    age_bin     = ifelse(Age == ">=60", 1, 0),                 # ADDED
    sex_bin     = ifelse(sex == "Male", 1, 0),
    smoking_bin = ifelse(smoking == "never smoker", 0, 1),
    stage_bin   = ifelse(stage == 4, 1, 0),
    adeno_bin   = ifelse(histo_detail == "Adenocarcinoma", 1, 0),
    risk_bin    = ifelse(RiskGroup == "High", 1, 0),
    time        = as.numeric(Time.Dead),
    status      = as.integer(dead.status)
  )

cat("Samples:", nrow(clin), "| Events:", sum(clin$status), "\n")
cat("Age distribution:\n");   print(table(clin$Age,       useNA = "ifany"))
cat("Stage distribution:\n"); print(table(clin$stage_bin, useNA = "ifany"))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 2: Univariate Cox
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
surv_obj <- Surv(time = clin$time, event = clin$status)

vars <- list(
  list(var = "age_bin",     label = "Age (\u226560 vs <60)"),  # ADDED
  list(var = "sex_bin",     label = "Sex (Male vs Female)"),
  list(var = "smoking_bin", label = "Smoking (Ever vs Never)"),
  list(var = "stage_bin",   label = "Stage (IV vs III)"),
  list(var = "adeno_bin",   label = "Histology (Adeno vs Other)"),
  list(var = "RiskScore",   label = "3-miRNA risk score (continuous)") # UPDATED
)

uni_list <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
  tryCatch({
    fit <- coxph(as.formula(paste0("surv_obj ~ ", v$var)),
                 data = clin, ties = "efron")
    s   <- summary(fit)
    data.frame(
      Variable   = v$label,
      var_name   = v$var,
      HR         = s$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"],
      HR_lower95 = s$conf.int[1, "lower .95"],
      HR_upper95 = s$conf.int[1, "upper .95"],
      p_value    = s$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Skipped ", v$label, ": ", e$message)
    data.frame(Variable = v$label, var_name = v$var,
               HR = NA, HR_lower95 = NA, HR_upper95 = NA, p_value = NA)
  })
})

uni_results <- bind_rows(uni_list)

cat("\n─── Univariate Cox results ───\n")
print(uni_results %>%
  mutate(across(c(HR, HR_lower95, HR_upper95), ~round(., 3)),
         p_value = round(p_value, 4)))

write.csv(uni_results,
          "Univariate_clinical_Cox_borda_zscore.csv",          # UPDATED
          row.names = FALSE)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 3: Multivariate Cox
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
clin_vars_sig <- uni_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(var_name != "RiskScore", !is.na(p_value), p_value < 0.10) %>%
  dplyr::pull(var_name)

cat("\nClinical variables entering multivariate (p<0.10):",
    paste(clin_vars_sig, collapse = ", "), "\n")

multi_vars    <- c("RiskScore", clin_vars_sig)
cat("Final multivariate variables:", paste(multi_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")

multi_formula <- as.formula(
  paste0("surv_obj ~ ", paste(multi_vars, collapse = " + "))
)
multi_fit     <- coxph(multi_formula, data = clin, ties = "efron")
multi_summary <- summary(multi_fit)

cat("\n─── Multivariate Cox results ───\n")
print(multi_summary)
cat("\nMultivariate C-index:", round(multi_summary$concordance["C"], 3), "\n")
cat("LRT p-value:         ", round(multi_summary$logtest["pvalue"], 4), "\n")

var_labels <- c(
  "RiskScore"   = "3-miRNA risk score",                        # UPDATED
  "age_bin"     = "Age (\u226560 vs <60)",                     # ADDED
  "sex_bin"     = "Sex (Male vs Female)",
  "smoking_bin" = "Smoking (Ever vs Never)",
  "stage_bin"   = "Stage (IV vs III)",
  "adeno_bin"   = "Histology (Adeno vs Other)"
)

multi_results <- data.frame(
  Variable   = var_labels[rownames(multi_summary$coefficients)],
  var_name   = rownames(multi_summary$coefficients),
  HR         = multi_summary$conf.int[, "exp(coef)"],
  HR_lower95 = multi_summary$conf.int[, "lower .95"],
  HR_upper95 = multi_summary$conf.int[, "upper .95"],
  p_value    = multi_summary$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      p_value < 0.10  ~ ".",
      TRUE            ~ ""
    )
  )

cat("\n─── Multivariate Cox clean results ───\n")
print(multi_results %>%
  mutate(across(c(HR, HR_lower95, HR_upper95), ~round(., 3)),
         p_value = round(p_value, 4)))

write.csv(multi_results,
          "Multivariate_clinical_Cox_borda_zscore.csv",        # UPDATED
          row.names = FALSE)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 4: Shared data preparation for both forest plots
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
forest_df <- uni_results %>%
  dplyr::rename(HR_uni = HR, lo_uni = HR_lower95,
                hi_uni = HR_upper95, p_uni = p_value) %>%
  left_join(
    dplyr::select(multi_results,
                  var_name, HR_mul = HR, lo_mul = HR_lower95,
                  hi_mul = HR_upper95, p_mul = p_value),
    by = "var_name"
  ) %>%
  arrange(var_name == "RiskScore")   # RiskScore last

n_rows <- nrow(forest_df)

fmt_p  <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "\u2014",
                              ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001",
                                     sprintf("%.3f", p)))
fmt_hr <- function(hr, lo, hi) ifelse(is.na(hr), "\u2014",
                                       sprintf("%.2f (%.2f\u2013%.2f)",
                                               hr, lo, hi))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PLOT A: Plain forestplot (publication-ready classic style)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
label_text <- cbind(
  c("Variable",          forest_df$Variable),
  c("Uni HR (95% CI)",   fmt_hr(forest_df$HR_uni, forest_df$lo_uni, forest_df$hi_uni)),
  c("Uni p",             fmt_p(forest_df$p_uni)),
  c("Multi HR (95% CI)", fmt_hr(forest_df$HR_mul, forest_df$lo_mul, forest_df$hi_mul)),
  c("Multi p",           fmt_p(forest_df$p_mul))
)

# Plot UNIVARIATE HR as the main point in plain style
hr_vec   <- c(NA, forest_df$HR_uni)
ci_lower <- c(NA, forest_df$lo_uni)
ci_upper <- c(NA, forest_df$hi_uni)

box_colors_plain <- c(
  "black",
  ifelse(forest_df$var_name == "RiskScore", "#B22222", "#1874CD")
)

fp_args_plain <- list(
  labeltext          = label_text,
  mean               = hr_vec,
  lower              = ci_lower,
  upper              = ci_upper,
  is.summary         = c(TRUE, rep(FALSE, n_rows)),
  zero               = 1,
  xlog               = TRUE,
  clip               = c(0.05, 20),
  xticks             = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10),
  xlab               = "Hazard Ratio (log scale) — Univariate",
  boxsize            = 0.22,
  lineheight         = unit(9, "mm"),
  ci.vertices        = TRUE,
  ci.vertices.height = 0.12,
  grid               = TRUE,
  grid.gp            = gpar(lty = 2, col = "grey80", lwd = 0.7),
  col = fpColors(
    box     = box_colors_plain,
    line    = "grey30",
    zero    = "black",
    summary = "grey50"
  ),
  title = paste0(
    "Univariate and multivariate Cox regression\n",
    "n = 34  |  18 events  |  Red = 3-miRNA risk score  |  z-scored ComBat expression"
  ),
  txt_gp = fpTxtGp(
    label   = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    ticks   = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    xlab    = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    title   = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
    summary = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold")
  ),
  colgap     = unit(2, "mm"),
  graphwidth = unit(45, "mm"),
  align      = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c")
)

pdf_h <- max(4, 1.8 + n_rows * 0.4)
pdf("forestplot_clinical_plain_borda_zscore.pdf",              # UPDATED
    width = 14, height = pdf_h)

    width = 1500, height = png_h, res = 130)
```
