```{r}
dev.off()
cat("Plain forest plot saved\n")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PLOT B: Colored ggplot style — two panels (Univariate | Multivariate)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
library(patchwork)

# Color logic
forest_df <- forest_df %>%
  mutate(
    Type = case_when(
      var_name == "RiskScore" ~ "3-miRNA Risk Score",
      TRUE                    ~ "Clinical Variable"
    ),
    # Direction from multivariate (NA if not in model)
    Direction_mul = case_when(
      is.na(HR_mul)  ~ "Not in model",
      HR_mul > 1     ~ "Risk (HR > 1)",
      TRUE           ~ "Protective (HR < 1)"
    ),
    Direction_uni = case_when(
      is.na(HR_uni) ~ "Not tested",
      HR_uni > 1    ~ "Risk (HR > 1)",
      TRUE          ~ "Protective (HR < 1)"
    ),
    # Display label
    label     = factor(Variable, levels = rev(Variable)),
    sig_uni   = ifelse(p_uni < 0.05, "*", ""),
    sig_mul   = ifelse(!is.na(p_mul) & p_mul < 0.05, "*", ""),
    annot_uni = paste0("HR=", round(HR_uni, 2),
                       " (", round(lo_uni, 2), "\u2013", round(hi_uni, 2), ")",
                       "  p=", fmt_p(p_uni)),
    annot_mul = ifelse(is.na(HR_mul), "Not in model",
                       paste0("HR=", round(HR_mul, 2),
                              " (", round(lo_mul, 2), "\u2013",
                              round(hi_mul, 2), ")",
                              "  p=", fmt_p(p_mul)))
  )

# Shared color scale
color_vals <- c(
  "Risk (HR > 1)"       = "#B22222",
  "Protective (HR < 1)" = "#1874CD",
  "Not in model"        = "grey70",
  "Not tested"          = "grey70"
)

ci_cap_uni <- quantile(forest_df$hi_uni, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.5
ci_cap_mul <- ifelse(all(is.na(forest_df$hi_mul)), ci_cap_uni,
                     quantile(forest_df$hi_mul, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.5)

# ── Panel A: Univariate ───────────────────────────────────────────
pA <- ggplot(forest_df,
             aes(x = HR_uni, y = label, color = Direction_uni)) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6) +

  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = pmax(lo_uni, 0.01),
        xmax = pmin(hi_uni, ci_cap_uni)),
    height = 0.3, linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  geom_point(aes(shape = Type), size = 3.5) +

  geom_text(
    aes(x = pmin(hi_uni, ci_cap_uni) + 0.05,
        label = annot_uni),
    hjust = 0, size = 2.6, color = "grey20"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = color_vals, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("3-miRNA Risk Score" = 18,
               "Clinical Variable"  = 16),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    name   = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI) — log scale",
    trans  = "log10",
    limits = c(0.1, ci_cap_uni * 3),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  labs(
    title    = "A   Univariate Cox",
    subtitle = "All clinical variables + 3-miRNA risk score",
    y        = NULL
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 9)
  )

# ── Panel B: Multivariate ─────────────────────────────────────────
pB <- ggplot(forest_df,
             aes(x = HR_mul, y = label, color = Direction_mul)) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6) +

  # Grey band for "not in model" rows
  geom_rect(
    data = filter(forest_df, is.na(HR_mul)),
    aes(xmin = 0.1, xmax = ci_cap_mul * 3,
        ymin = as.numeric(label) - 0.4,
        ymax = as.numeric(label) + 0.4),
    fill = "grey96", color = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_errorbarh(
    data = filter(forest_df, !is.na(HR_mul)),
    aes(xmin = pmax(lo_mul, 0.01),
        xmax = pmin(hi_mul, ci_cap_mul)),
    height = 0.3, linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = filter(forest_df, !is.na(HR_mul)),
    aes(shape = Type), size = 3.5
  ) +

  # "Not in model" label for excluded rows
  geom_text(
    data = filter(forest_df, is.na(HR_mul)),
    aes(x = 1, y = label, label = "Not in model"),
    hjust = 0.5, size = 2.8, color = "grey60", inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = filter(forest_df, !is.na(HR_mul)),
    aes(x = pmin(hi_mul, ci_cap_mul) + 0.05,
        label = annot_mul),
    hjust = 0, size = 2.6, color = "grey20"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = color_vals, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("3-miRNA Risk Score" = 18,
               "Clinical Variable"  = 16),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    name   = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI) — log scale",
    trans  = "log10",
    limits = c(0.1, ci_cap_mul * 3),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  labs(
    title    = "B   Multivariate Cox",
    subtitle = "Adjusted for clinical variables with p < 0.10 in univariate",
    y        = NULL
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 9)
  )

# ── Combine ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
combined_forest <- pA | pB +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

combined_forest <- combined_forest +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Clinical independence — univariate and multivariate Cox regression",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "n = 34  |  18 events  |  3-miRNA risk score (diamond)  |  ",
      "z-scored ComBat expression  |  Clinical variables (circle)"
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9)
    )
  )

plot_h <- max(5, 1.8 + n_rows * 0.5)
ggsave("forestplot_clinical_colored_borda_zscore.png",         # UPDATED
       combined_forest, width = 16, height = plot_h, dpi = 300)
ggsave("forestplot_clinical_colored_borda_zscore.pdf",         # UPDATED
       combined_forest, width = 16, height = plot_h)

print(combined_forest)
cat("Colored forest plot saved\n")

cat("\n═══ Complete ═══\n")
cat("Files saved:\n")
cat("  Univariate_clinical_Cox_borda_zscore.csv\n")
cat("  Multivariate_clinical_Cox_borda_zscore.csv\n")
cat("  forestplot_clinical_plain_borda_zscore.pdf/png   ← classic style\n")
cat("  forestplot_clinical_colored_borda_zscore.pdf/png ← ggplot colored style\n")
```

#monogram
```{r}
library(rms)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 1: Load data
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
metadata <- read.csv("Metadata_Limma_dead_time_all.csv")
risk_df  <- read.csv("RiskScore_results_borda_zscore.csv")     # UPDATED

df <- metadata %>%
  left_join(risk_df %>% select(SampleID, RiskScore, RiskGroup),
            by = "SampleID") %>%
  mutate(
    age_bin     = factor(ifelse(Age == ">=60", ">=60", "<60"),
                         levels = c("<60", ">=60")),
    sex_bin     = factor(ifelse(sex == "Male", "Male", "Female"),
                         levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    smoking_bin = factor(ifelse(smoking == "never smoker",
                                "Never", "Ever"),
                         levels = c("Never", "Ever")),
    stage_bin   = factor(ifelse(stage == 4, "IV", "III"),
                         levels = c("III", "IV")),
    adeno_bin   = factor(ifelse(histo_detail == "Adenocarcinoma",
                                "Adeno", "Other"),
                         levels = c("Other", "Adeno")),
    os_months   = as.numeric(Time.Dead),                       # FIXED: renamed
    os_status   = as.integer(dead.status)                      # FIXED: renamed
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(os_months), !is.na(RiskScore))

cat("Samples:", nrow(df), "| Events:", sum(df$os_status), "\n")

# ── Diagnostic: follow-up range ───────────────────────────────────
cat("\nFollow-up time summary (months):\n")
print(summary(df$os_months))
cat("Max follow-up:", max(df$os_months), "months\n")

cat("\nEvents at each candidate timepoint:\n")
for (tp in c(6, 12, 18, 24, 36)) {
  n_risk   <- sum(df$os_months >= tp)
  n_events <- sum(df$os_status[df$os_months >= tp])
  cat(sprintf("  ≥ %2d months: %d patients at risk, %d events\n",
              tp, n_risk, n_events))
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 2: rms setup — datadist MUST be set before cph()
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
dd <- datadist(df)
options(datadist = "dd")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 3: Fit Cox model using rms::cph
# Include risk score + clinical variables that were sig in multivariate
# Adjust var list based on your multivariate results
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
fit <- cph(
  Surv(os_months, os_status) ~ RiskScore + age_bin + sex_bin +
                                smoking_bin + stage_bin + adeno_bin,
  data    = df,
  x       = TRUE,   # REQUIRED for nomogram + calibration
  y       = TRUE,   # REQUIRED for nomogram + calibration
  surv    = TRUE,   # REQUIRED for survival predictions
  ties    = "efron"
)

cat("\n─── rms::cph model ───\n")
print(fit)
cat("\nC-index:", round(fit$stats["Dxy"] / 2 + 0.5, 3), "\n")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 4: Define survival function — FIXED
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
mean_lp <- mean(predict(fit))   # centering point

surv_fn_lp <- function(tp, lp) {
  sf <- survest(fit, times = tp, conf.int = FALSE)
  s0 <- sf$surv[1]              # baseline survival at tp
  s0^exp(lp - mean_lp)          # S(t|lp) = S0(t)^exp(lp - mean_lp)
}

lp_seq   <- seq(range(predict(fit))[1],
                range(predict(fit))[2],
                length.out = 200)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 5: Auto-select valid timepoints
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
candidate_times  <- c(6, 12, 18, 24, 36)
candidate_labels <- c("6-month OS", "1-year OS", "18-month OS",
                      "2-year OS",  "3-year OS")

valid_tp  <- c()
valid_lbl <- c()

for (i in seq_along(candidate_times)) {
  tp  <- candidate_times[i]
  n   <- sum(df$os_months >= tp)

  sv <- tryCatch(
    survest(fit, times = tp, what = "survival",
            conf.int = FALSE)$surv,
    error = function(e) NA
  )

  has_range <- !all(is.na(sv)) &&
               (max(sv, na.rm = TRUE) - min(sv, na.rm = TRUE)) > 0.05

  if (n >= 10 && has_range) {
    valid_tp  <- c(valid_tp,  tp)
    valid_lbl <- c(valid_lbl, candidate_labels[i])
    cat(sprintf("  ✓ %d months: n=%d at risk, range=%.3f\u2013%.3f\n",
                tp, n, min(sv, na.rm=TRUE), max(sv, na.rm=TRUE)))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  ✗ %d months: n=%d — excluded\n", tp, n))
  }
}

# Use at most 3 timepoints
if (length(valid_tp) > 3) {
  valid_tp  <- valid_tp[1:3]
  valid_lbl <- valid_lbl[1:3]
}

cat("\nSelected timepoints:", paste(valid_tp, "mo", collapse = ", "), "\n")

if (length(valid_tp) == 0) {
  stop("No valid timepoints. Check os_months values.")
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 6: Build fun.at list — robust to narrow ranges
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
safe_fun_at <- function(tp, steps = 0.1) {
  sv <- tryCatch(
    survest(fit, times = tp, what = "survival",
            conf.int = FALSE)$surv,
    error = function(e) NA
  )
  sv <- sv[!is.na(sv) & is.finite(sv)]

  if (length(sv) < 2) {
    cat("  Warning: timepoint", tp, "< 2 valid values — using c(0.1, 0.9)\n")
    return(c(0.1, 0.9))
  }

  lo <- ceiling(min(sv) / steps) * steps
  hi <- floor(max(sv)   / steps) * steps

  if (lo >= hi) {
    return(round(seq(min(sv), max(sv), length.out = 5), 2))
  }
  round(seq(lo, hi, by = steps), 2)
}

fun_at_list <- lapply(valid_tp, safe_fun_at)

cat("\nfun.at ranges:\n")
for (i in seq_along(valid_tp)) {
  cat(" ", valid_lbl[i], ":", fun_at_list[[i]], "\n")
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 7: Build nomogram — FIXED fun_list
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# fun_list: each function takes lp vector x → returns survival vector
fun_list <- lapply(valid_tp, function(tp) {
  local({
    t <- tp
    function(x) surv_fn_lp(t, x)   # FIXED: uses x (lp) correctly
  })
})

# Rebuild fun_at_list using corrected surv_fn_lp
safe_fun_at <- function(tp, steps = 0.1) {
  sv <- surv_fn_lp(tp, lp_seq)
  sv <- sv[!is.na(sv) & is.finite(sv)]

  if (length(sv) < 2) {
    cat("  Warning: timepoint", tp, "— using c(0.1, 0.9)\n")
    return(c(0.1, 0.9))
  }

  lo <- ceiling(min(sv) / steps) * steps
  hi <- floor(max(sv)   / steps) * steps

  if (lo >= hi) {
    return(round(seq(min(sv), max(sv), length.out = 5), 2))
  }
  round(seq(lo, hi, by = steps), 2)
}

fun_at_list <- lapply(valid_tp, safe_fun_at)

cat("\nfun.at ranges:\n")
for (i in seq_along(valid_tp)) {
  cat(" ", valid_lbl[i], ":", fun_at_list[[i]], "\n")
}

nom <- nomogram(
  fit,
  fun      = fun_list,
  funlabel = valid_lbl,
  lp       = FALSE,
  fun.at   = fun_at_list
)

cat("Nomogram built successfully\n")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 8: Plot and save
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
title_str <- sprintf(
  "Nomogram for predicting overall survival\n3-miRNA risk score + clinical variables  (n = %d)",  # UPDATED
  nrow(df)
)

# PNG
png("Nomogram_3miRNA_borda_zscore.png",                        # UPDATED
    width = 3400, height = 2200, res = 300)
par(mar = c(2, 1, 3, 1), family = "sans")
plot(nom,
     xfrac              = 0.38,
     label.every        = 1,
     tcl                = -0.30,
     lmgp               = 0.25,
     col.grid           = gray(c(0.82, 0.93)),
     varname.label      = TRUE,
     varname.label.sep  = "= ",
     cex.axis           = 0.75,
     cex.var            = 0.82,
     points.label       = "Points",
     total.points.label = "Total points",
     main               = title_str)
dev.off()
cat("Nomogram_3miRNA_borda_zscore.png saved\n")

# PDF
pdf("Nomogram_3miRNA_borda_zscore.pdf", width = 13, height = 8.5)  # UPDATED
par(mar = c(2, 1, 3, 1), family = "sans")
plot(nom,
     xfrac              = 0.38,
     label.every        = 1,
     tcl                = -0.30,
     lmgp               = 0.25,
     col.grid           = gray(c(0.82, 0.93)),
     varname.label      = TRUE,
     cex.axis           = 0.75,
     cex.var            = 0.82,
     main               = title_str)
dev.off()
cat("Nomogram_3miRNA_borda_zscore.pdf saved\n")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 9: Calibration curves
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
n_tp <- length(valid_tp)

png("Calibration_curves_3miRNA_borda_zscore.png",              # UPDATED
    width  = 900 * n_tp,
    height = 950,
    res    = 300)
par(mfrow = c(1, n_tp),
    mar   = c(4.5, 4.5, 3.5, 1.5),
    family = "sans")

for (i in seq_along(valid_tp)) {
  tp  <- valid_tp[i]
  lbl <- valid_lbl[i]

  cal <- tryCatch(
    calibrate(fit, u = tp, B = 200, cmethod = "KM"),
    error = function(e) {
      message("Calibration failed for ", lbl, ": ", e$message)
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(cal)) {
    plot(cal,
         xlim      = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1),
         xlab      = "Predicted probability",
         ylab      = "Observed probability",
         main      = paste0(lbl, " calibration"),
         subtitles = FALSE,
         col       = "steelblue", lwd = 1.5)
    abline(0, 1, col = "grey50", lty = 2, lwd = 1)
    legend("topleft",
           legend = c("Calibration", "Ideal"),
           col    = c("steelblue", "grey50"),
           lty    = c(1, 2), lwd = c(1.5, 1),
           bty    = "n", cex = 0.75)
    cat("Calibration plotted:", lbl, "\n")
  }
}
dev.off()
cat("Calibration_curves_3miRNA_borda_zscore.png saved\n")

cat("\n═══ Nomogram complete ═══\n")
cat("Files saved:\n")
cat("  Nomogram_3miRNA_borda_zscore.png/.pdf\n")
cat("  Calibration_curves_3miRNA_borda_zscore.png\n")
```

#calculates risk score first, then correlates with all clinical variables:
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)

# ── 1. Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
combat  <- read.csv("combat_counts.csv", check.names = FALSE)
meta    <- read.csv("Metadata_Limma_dead_time_all.csv")

# ── 2. Calculate Risk Score ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Extract the 3 miRNAs (column names use dots)
mir_cols <- c("hsa.miR.509.3p", "hsa.miR.377.3p", "hsa.miR.378h")

expr <- combat[, c("SampleID", mir_cols)]

# log2(x+1) transform then z-score each miRNA
expr_z <- expr
for (col in mir_cols) {
  log_val         <- log2(expr[[col]] + 1)
  expr_z[[col]]   <- as.numeric(scale(log_val))
}

# Apply Cox betas
expr_z$risk_score <- (0.743073 * expr_z$hsa.miR.509.3p) +
                     (0.502724 * expr_z$hsa.miR.377.3p)  +
                    (-0.663259 * expr_z$hsa.miR.378h)

# ── 3. Classify High / Low risk by median ────────────────────────────────
expr_z$risk_group <- ifelse(expr_z$risk_score >= median(expr_z$risk_score),
                             "High", "Low")

# ── 4. Merge with metadata ────────────────────────────────────────────────
df <- merge(meta, expr_z[, c("SampleID", "risk_score", "risk_group")],
            by = "SampleID")

write.csv(df, "metadata_with_risk_score.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("High risk:", sum(df$risk_group == "High"), "\n")
cat("Low risk: ", sum(df$risk_group == "Low"),  "\n")

# ── 5. Boxplot: Risk Score Distribution ───────────────────────────────────
p_dist <- ggplot(df, aes(x = risk_group, y = risk_score, fill = risk_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("High" = "#E15759", "Low" = "#4E79A7")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Risk Score Distribution",
       x = "Risk Group", y = "Risk Score") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

# ── 6. Clinical Correlations ──────────────────────────────────────────────

# --- 6a. Sex ---
p_sex <- ggplot(df, aes(x = sex, fill = risk_group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("High" = "#E15759", "Low" = "#4E79A7")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Sex", x = NULL, y = "Proportion", fill = "Risk Group") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

# --- 6b. Smoking ---
p_smoking <- ggplot(df, aes(x = smoking, fill = risk_group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("High" = "#E15759", "Low" = "#4E79A7")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Smoking Status", x = NULL, y = "Proportion", fill = "Risk Group") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

# --- 6c. Histology ---
p_histo <- ggplot(df, aes(x = histo_detail, fill = risk_group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("High" = "#E15759", "Low" = "#4E79A7")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Histology", x = NULL, y = "Proportion", fill = "Risk Group") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

# --- 6d. AJCC Stage ---
p_stage <- ggplot(df, aes(x = ajcc8_stage, fill = risk_group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("High" = "#E15759", "Low" = "#4E79A7")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "AJCC Stage", x = NULL, y = "Proportion", fill = "Risk Group") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

# --- 6e. Age ---
p_age <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Age, fill = risk_group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("High" = "#E15759", "Low" = "#4E79A7")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Age Group", x = NULL, y = "Proportion", fill = "Risk Group") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

# --- 6f. First-line treatment ---
p_treat <- ggplot(df, aes(x = firstline_detail, fill = risk_group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("High" = "#E15759", "Low" = "#4E79A7")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "First-line Treatment", x = NULL, y = "Proportion", fill = "Risk Group") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

# --- 6g. Risk Score by Stage (continuous) ---
p_stage_box <- ggplot(df, aes(x = ajcc8_stage, y = risk_score, fill = ajcc8_stage)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label = "p.format") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Risk Score by AJCC Stage",
       x = "AJCC Stage", y = "Risk Score") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

# ── 7. Combine all plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
final_clinical <- (p_dist | p_sex | p_smoking) /
                  (p_histo | p_stage | p_age) /
                  (p_treat | p_stage_box | plot_spacer()) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Risk Score — Clinical Correlations",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold",
                                             hjust = 0.5, color = "#225577"))
  )

print(final_clinical)
ggsave("Clinical_Correlation.png", final_clinical,
       width = 18, height = 16, dpi = 300)

# ── 8. Chi-square tests for categorical variables ─────────────────────────
cat_vars <- c("sex", "smoking", "histo_detail", "ajcc8_stage", "Age", "firstline_detail")

chi_results <- lapply(cat_vars, function(var) {
  tbl <- table(df[[var]], df$risk_group)
  test <- chisq.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE)
  data.frame(Variable = var, p_value = round(test$p.value, 4))
})

chi_table <- do.call(rbind, chi_results)
chi_table$Significant <- ifelse(chi_table$p_value < 0.05, "Yes", "No")

print(chi_table)
write.csv(chi_table, "clinical_chisq_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


#new clinical plot
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)

# ── 1. Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
combat <- read.csv("combat_counts.csv", check.names = FALSE)
meta   <- read.csv("Metadata_Limma_dead_time_all.csv")

# ── 2. Calculate Risk Score ───────────────────────────────────────────────
mir_cols <- c("hsa.miR.509.3p", "hsa.miR.377.3p", "hsa.miR.378h")
expr     <- combat[, c("SampleID", mir_cols)]

for (col in mir_cols) {
  log_val       <- log2(expr[[col]] + 1)
  expr[[col]]   <- as.numeric(scale(log_val))
}

expr$risk_score <- (0.743073 * expr$hsa.miR.509.3p) +
                   (0.502724 * expr$hsa.miR.377.3p)  +
                  (-0.663259 * expr$hsa.miR.378h)

expr$risk_group <- ifelse(expr$risk_score >= median(expr$risk_score),
                           "High", "Low")

# ── 3. Merge with metadata ────────────────────────────────────────────────
df <- merge(meta, expr[, c("SampleID", "risk_score", "risk_group")],
            by = "SampleID")

# ── 4. Reclassify clinical variables ─────────────────────────────────────

# Smoking: never vs ever
df$smoking_group <- ifelse(df$smoking == "never smoker", "Never", "Ever")
df$smoking_group <- factor(df$smoking_group, levels = c("Never", "Ever"))

# Histology: Adeno / Squamous / Other
df$histo_group <- case_when(
  df$histo_detail == "Adenocarcinoma"         ~ "Adeno",
  df$histo_detail == "Squamous cell carcinoma" ~ "Squamous",
  TRUE                                         ~ "Other"
)
df$histo_group <- factor(df$histo_group, levels = c("Adeno", "Squamous", "Other"))

# Stage: III vs IV
df$stage_group <- ifelse(grepl("^III", df$ajcc8_stage), "Stage III", "Stage IV")
df$stage_group <- factor(df$stage_group, levels = c("Stage III", "Stage IV"))

# Treatment: Chemo / Immuno / Chemo+Immuno, from the first-line treatment category
# (GEO characteristic; regimen names are not shared)
df$treat_group <- case_when(
  df$firstline_category == "immunotherapy"                          ~ "Immuno",
  df$firstline_category == "chemotherapy followed by immunotherapy" ~ "Chemo+Immuno",
  TRUE                                                              ~ "Chemo"
)
df$treat_group <- factor(df$treat_group, levels = c("Chemo", "Immuno", "Chemo+Immuno"))

# Save classified data
write.csv(df, "metadata_with_risk_score.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ── 5. Color palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
risk_colors <- c("High" = "#E15759", "Low" = "#4E79A7")

# ── 6. Plot function (stacked bar) ────────────────────────────────────────
make_bar_plot <- function(data, x_var, title) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[x_var]], fill = risk_group)) +
    geom_bar(position = "fill", width = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = risk_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Proportion", fill = "Risk Group") +
    theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
          axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 10),
          legend.position = "right")
}

# ── 7. Individual plots ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Risk score distribution
p_dist <- ggplot(df, aes(x = risk_group, y = risk_score, fill = risk_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2.5) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = risk_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Risk Score Distribution", x = "Risk Group", y = "Risk Score") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 11))

p_smoking <- make_bar_plot(df, "smoking_group", "Smoking Status")
p_histo   <- make_bar_plot(df, "histo_group",   "Histology")
p_stage   <- make_bar_plot(df, "stage_group",   "Clinical Stage")
p_treat   <- make_bar_plot(df, "treat_group",   "First-line Treatment")

# Risk score by stage (continuous)
p_stage_box <- ggplot(df, aes(x = stage_group, y = risk_score, fill = stage_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2.5) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Stage III" = "#59A14F", "Stage IV" = "#F28E2B")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Risk Score by Stage", x = NULL, y = "Risk Score") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 11))

# ── 8. Combine ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
final_plot <- (p_dist | p_smoking | p_histo) /
              (p_stage | p_treat  | p_stage_box) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Risk Score — Clinical Correlations",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold",
                                             hjust = 0.5, color = "#225577"))
  )

print(final_plot)
ggsave("Clinical_Correlation.png", final_plot,
       width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300)

# ── 9. Chi-square tests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat_vars <- list(
  "Smoking"   = "smoking_group",
  "Histology" = "histo_group",
  "Stage"     = "stage_group",
  "Treatment" = "treat_group",
  "Sex"       = "sex",
  "Age"       = "Age"
)

chi_results <- lapply(names(cat_vars), function(label) {
  var  <- cat_vars[[label]]
  tbl  <- table(df[[var]], df$risk_group)
  test <- chisq.test(tbl, simulate.p.value = TRUE)
  data.frame(Variable    = label,
             p_value     = round(test$p.value, 4),
             Significant = ifelse(test$p.value < 0.05, "Yes", "No"))
})

chi_table <- do.call(rbind, chi_results)
print(chi_table)
write.csv(chi_table, "clinical_chisq_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
